keyInsights: Taste/Flavour is the dominant purchase driver across all conditions, ranked #1 by 41–53% of participants.

Brand Trust is the second most important factor, rising from 26.6% (Var A) to 31.4% (Var B) when price is neutralized — confirming that removing price elevates brand identity as the primary differentiator.
Heineken buyers lead at 63% in Variant A and 44% in Variant B citing Brand Trust as their #1 factor — the highest trust-driven selection rate of any brand.
Price drops dramatically as a motivator in Variant B (11.8% → 5.2%), confirming the flat-pricing manipulation was effective.
Health remains a minor factor across all conditions (1–5%), even among Very Active consumer segments.
